<?php
class Owner188Cell { public function capture() { return function &() { $child = new class { public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; return $child; }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
$owner = new Owner188Cell; $factory = $owner->capture(); unset($owner); $value =& $factory(); echo 'MADE;'; unset($factory); echo 'HELD;'; unset($value); echo 'DONE;';

<?php
class Owner188Arrow { public function capture() { return fn &() => new class { public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
$owner = new Owner188Arrow; $factory = $owner->capture(); unset($owner); $value =& $factory(); echo 'MADE;'; unset($factory); echo 'HELD;'; unset($value); echo 'DONE;';

<?php
function warn188($severity, $message) { echo 'WARN;'; throw new Exception('stop'); }
class Owner188Throw { public function capture() { return fn &() => new class { public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
set_error_handler('warn188'); try { $value =& ((new Owner188Throw)->capture())(); } catch (Exception $e) { echo 'CAUGHT;'; }

<?php
trait T188Scope { public function &capture() { $factory = function &() { $child = new class(self::VALUE, static::VALUE, __CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $self, public int $called, public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; return $child; }; return $factory; } }
class A188Scope { use T188Scope; public const VALUE = 1; } class B188Scope { use T188Scope; public const VALUE = 2; } class C188Scope extends A188Scope { public const VALUE = 3; }
$a = new C188Scope; $b = new B188Scope; $fa =& $a->capture(); $fb =& $b->capture(); unset($a, $b); $x =& $fa(); $y =& $fb(); $after = new class {}; echo $x->self, ':', $x->called, ':', $x->owner, ':', $x->method, ';', $y->self, ':', $y->called, ':', $y->owner, ':', $y->method, ';', ($x::class === $y::class), ';', $x::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class { public function &capture() { $factory = static function &() { $child = new class(__CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; return $child; }; return $factory; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } };
$factory =& $owner->capture(); unset($owner); $child =& $factory(); $after = new class {}; echo $child->owner, ';', $child->method, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';';
